Příliš žluťoučký kůň úpěl ďábelské ódy.[^1] The grid was rigid,{>> cf. Gerstner, 1964 <<} and the margins were wide.[^gerstner]

An emoji 📚 comes before this reference.[^3] Then an aside with *emphasis* and a [link](https://example.com).{>> See *Programme* and [the catalogue](https://example.com/catalogue). <<}

A long aside follows.{>> This margin note is deliberately long, so that on a wide screen it runs well past the line that references it and pushes the next note down instead of overlapping it. It keeps going for a while to make that happen. <<} More text.[^4]

Code is never a note: `{>> not a note <<}` stays as written.

```
{>> also not a note <<}
```

Fifth[^5], sixth[^6], seventh[^7].{>> m-four <<} Eighth[^8], ninth[^9], tenth[^10].

[^1]: Brno, 1971.
[^gerstner]: Karl Gerstner, *Designing Programmes*, 1964.
[^3]: An emoji note.

[^6]: Sixth.
